examples.en: They got the fire under control at last.
examples.zh: 他们终于控制住了火势。

examples.en: Smoke still rose up from the ground.
Smoke rose over the desolate hills.
examples.zh: 烟雾从荒凉的山丘上升起。

examples.en: The hills threatened the villages with destruction.
examples.zh: 山丘威胁着村庄，会带来毁灭。

examples.en: Heavy rain would cause serious floods.
examples.zh: 大雨会引起严重的洪水。

examples.en: The forest authorities ordered some grass-seed.
examples.zh: 森林管理局订购了一些草籽。

examples.en: They sprayed the grass-seed over the ground.
The seed was sprayed by aeroplanes.
The seed was sprayed in huge quantities.
The grass had already taken root.
Patches of green appeared in the soil.
examples.zh: 一块块绿色出现在土壤中。

examples.en: The soil was blackened by the fire.
The hills threatened the surrounding villages.
examples.zh: 山丘威胁着周围的村庄。

examples.en: The trees had been growing for centuries.
examples.zh: 这些树已经生长了几个世纪。

examples.en: The rain would wash away the soil.

sentences.en: Heavy rain would not only wash away the soil but would cause serious floods as well.
sentences.zh: 大雨不仅会冲走土壤，还会引起严重的洪水。

sentences.en: The seed was sprayed over the ground in huge quantities by aeroplanes.
sentences.zh: 飞机把大量草籽撒在了地面上。

sentences.en: Winter was coming on and the hills threatened the surrounding villages with destruction.
sentences.zh: 冬天即将来临，这些山丘威胁着周围的村庄，会带来毁灭。

sentences.en: The planes had been planting seed for nearly a month when it began to rain.
sentences.zh: 飞机撒种撒了将近一个月，天开始下雨了。

sentences.en: By then, however, in many places the grass had already taken root.
sentences.zh: 然而到那时，许多地方的草已经扎根了。

article.en: Firemen had been fighting the forest fire for nearly three weeks before they could get it under control.
article.zh: 消防员同森林大火搏斗了将近三个星期才把火势控制住。

article.en: A short time before, great trees had covered the countryside for miles around.
article.zh: 不久前，大片树木还覆盖着方圆数英里的乡村。

article.en: Now, smoke still rose up from the warm ground over the desolate hills.
article.zh: 现在，烟雾仍然从荒凉的山丘上温暖的地面升起。

article.en: Winter was coming on and the hills threatened the surrounding villages with destruction.
article.zh: 冬天即将来临，这些山丘威胁着周围的村庄，会带来毁灭。

article.en: Heavy rain would not only wash away the soil but would cause serious floods as well.
article.zh: 大雨不仅会冲走土壤，还会引起严重的洪水。

article.en: When the fire had at last been put out, the forest authorities ordered several tons of a special type of grass-seed which would grow quickly.
article.zh: 大火终于被扑灭后，森林管理局订购了好几吨能快速生长的特殊草籽。

article.en: The seed was sprayed over the ground in huge quantities by aeroplanes.
article.zh: 飞机把大量草籽撒在了地面上。

article.en: The planes had been planting seed for nearly a month when it began to rain.
article.zh: 飞机撒种撒了将近一个月，天开始下雨了。

article.en: By then, however, in many places the grass had already taken root.
article.zh: 然而到那时，许多地方的草已经扎根了。

article.en: In place of the great trees which had been growing there for centuries, patches of green had begun to appear in the blackened soil.
article.zh: 在那些生长了几个世纪的大树原来的地方，一块块绿草开始出现在烧黑的土地上。
